# MapleStory Classic Tool

A screen-reading companion for **MapleStory Classic** on Windows. It watches the
game window, reads what is on screen, and draws helpful information on top of it:

- **Price checker.** Open any player shop in the Free Market and a list beside it
  shows which listings an NPC will buy for more than the asking price.
- **EXP tracker.** EXP per hour, the time until your next level, and the EXP
  gained this session.
- **Meso tracker.** Mesos per hour and mesos earned this session, read from your
  inventory.
- **Alt+Shift blocker.** Stops Windows from switching your keyboard language
  every time you press Alt+Shift in game.

The app is called **MapleStory Classic Tool** (`MapleStoryClassicTool.exe`).

> **It only reads the screen.** MapleStory Classic Tool takes screenshots of the game window and
> reads the pixels, the same way you read them with your eyes. It never opens,
> reads or writes the game's process or memory, never injects anything, never
> sends input to the game and never touches its network traffic.

![Price checker beside a player shop](docs/images/price-checker.png)

![EXP / meso tracker on the status bar](docs/images/exp-tracker.png)

*(The screenshots come from the test images, where the author's character name
is blurred.)*

## Features

### Price checker (Free Market player shops)

- When you open a player shop, a **side list** styled like the shop window
  appears next to it: left of the shop, or right of it when there is no room.
- The title reads `N items · D deals`. Below it, every listing an NPC buys for
  more than its price is shown, **most profitable first**: the item's icon and
  name, the shop's price line (`1 for 3,000 mesos`) and a green profit badge
  (`+12,345`).
- **Show all rows** (on by default) also lists the other items, each with a grey
  `NPC 1,234` badge showing what the NPC pays. Items MeowDB has no NPC price for
  are left out.
- **It remembers the whole shop.** Scroll through a shop once and every item stays
  listed until you close it. Identical listings show as `(x2)`. Hovering the
  shop's buttons doesn't clear the list; it stays as long as the shop's title is
  on screen.
- **Sold-out rows** (drawn faded by the game) are skipped.
- **Throwing stars and bullets** are valued as one set per listing.
- **Cut-off names.** If a name the shop cuts off (`Two-handed Axe Attack S...`)
  could be any of several scrolls worth the same to the NPC, it is shown as
  read rather than guessed.
- **Nothing is guessed.** A row that can't be read with confidence, or doesn't
  match the price list, is never shown or counted.
- NPC prices come from the [MeowDB](https://meowdb.com) item database. It is
  downloaded on first launch and cached locally.

### EXP tracker

It takes over the LV / job / character-name box at the bottom left of the status
bar, in the panel's own colours. The level stays visible in the corner, followed
by three lines:

| Line | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `EXP/h 1.2M`   `+312K` | EXP per hour over the last 10 minutes, and EXP gained this session |
| `Lv up 5m 33s`   `idle` | Time to the next level at the current rate (`idle` after 5 minutes without EXP) |
| `Meso/h 452K`   `+45.3K` | Mesos per hour and mesos earned this session, or `open inv` when the inventory is closed |

- It reads `EXP. 151,688 [56.88%]` from the status bar once per second, with or
  without a shop open.
- Numbers appear after one minute and two EXP gains. Until then the box shows
  `—`.
- **Idle time doesn't count.** After 5 minutes without EXP the rate freezes, and
  the idle gap is skipped once you start gaining again.
- **Level-ups** carry the gain over.
- **Misreads are thrown out.** EXP that goes down, or an EXP / percentage pair
  that doesn't fit, is discarded. EXP lost on death is never subtracted.
- **A new session starts** when you press **On**, or after you've been on a
  different map for 30 seconds. The map is told apart by the minimap's map name,
  in either the expanded or the collapsed minimap. Going back within 30 seconds
  keeps the session.
- The box hides while the status bar is hidden, for example in the Cash Shop.

### Meso tracker

- **Where it reads from.** Mesos are read from the item inventory's meso box. It
  still works when the inventory is dragged partly off the left edge, as long as
  the meso number is fully visible.
- **Only gains count**: drops, quest rewards, NPC sales. Spending is never
  subtracted.
- **No one-off misreads.** A new value counts only once two readings in a row
  agree.
- **Inventory closed.** The line says `open inv`. Mesos earned meanwhile are
  counted once it's open again.

### Alt+Shift language blocker

MapleStory players press Alt+Shift a lot. On a PC with several keyboard languages
it keeps switching the input language. While MapleStory Classic Tool is open:

- Windows' Alt+Shift language shortcut is turned off. It's the same setting as
  *Settings → Time & language → Typing → Advanced keyboard settings → Input
  language hot keys*.
- **Win+Space** still switches languages.
- **Closing MapleStory Classic Tool** (or unticking the box) puts the shortcut back exactly as
  it was. Your original setting is saved to a file first, so if MapleStory Classic Tool
  crashes, the next start restores it.
- It changes only your own Windows setting and never looks at the game.

---

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11.**
- **MapleStory Classic**, windowed or borderless, at any size and on any
  monitor.
  - The game draws its UI at a base height of 768 px, and MapleStory Classic Tool works out the
    matching scale on its own: 1366×768 at 3840×2160, 1228×768 at 2560×1600, and
    so on.
  - Exclusive fullscreen may hide the overlay.
- **Internet on first launch**, to download the MeowDB price list. After that it's
  cached and refreshed weekly.
- *Optional:* the **English Windows OCR language pack**. It's a fallback for text
  the built-in reader can't identify. Install it from *Settings → Time & language
  → Language → English (United States) → Optional features → OCR*.

## Getting started

### Option A: download the exe

Download `MapleStoryClassicTool.exe` from the
[latest release](https://github.com/oleg1994/maplestory-classic-tool/releases/latest)
and double-click it. Nothing to install. What changed in each version is in
[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

### Option B: build the exe

```bat
git clone https://github.com/oleg1994/maplestory-classic-tool.git
cd maplestory-classic-tool
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\pip install -e .[dev]
build.bat
```

This produces a single file, `dist\MapleStoryClassicTool.exe`. Double-click it to start.

To smoke-test the build without opening a window, run
`dist\MapleStoryClassicTool.exe --selftest` (exit code 0 means OK).

### Option C: run from source

```bat
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\pip install -e .[dev]
.venv\Scripts\python -m maplestory_classic_tool --gui
```

Requires Python 3.10 or newer.

## Using MapleStory Classic Tool

A small **MapleStory Classic Tool** window opens in the **Off** state. Nothing is
captured until you press **On**.

| Control | What it does |
|---|---|
| **On / Off** | Start and stop reading the screen. |
| **Show all rows** | Also list shop items that aren't a deal, with what the NPC pays (on by default; items with no NPC price on MeowDB are never listed). |
| **EXP tracker** | Show the EXP / meso box on the status bar. |
| **Block Alt+Shift language switch** | Turn Windows' Alt+Shift language shortcut off while MapleStory Classic Tool is open. |
| **Restart as admin** | Shown only when not elevated. Needed only if the game runs as administrator and you want the hotkeys below. |

The status line shows one of:

- `Off`
- `On - waiting for game`
- `On - no shop open`
- `On - shop found (N deals)`
- `No price data`

**Hotkeys** (global, so the game won't receive them while MapleStory Classic Tool runs):

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| **F8** | Rescan now and clear the collected shop list |
| **F9** | Hide the side list until it changes |

You can change them in `settings.json` (see below).

**Screenshots.** The overlay is hidden from screen capture: Print Screen, the
Snipping Tool, OBS and Discord streaming all show the game without it. This is
deliberate, because the tool's own capture must not see what it draws. Only one
copy runs at a time.

## Settings and files

Everything lives in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MapleStoryClassicTool`:

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `settings.json` | Your options: `show_all`, `exp_tracker`, `block_alt_shift`, hotkeys (`hotkey_scan`, `hotkey_clear`), `window_title`, `catalog_max_age_days` and the remembered UI scale per window size (`base_sizes`). |
| `catalog.json` | Cached MeowDB price list (refreshed when older than `catalog_max_age_days`, default 7). |
| `log.txt` | Log: window rectangle and UI scale, capture backend, memory use. |
| `lang_hotkey_backup.json` | Exists only while Alt+Shift is blocked: your original hotkey setting. |

MapleStory Classic Tool connects to the internet for only one thing: downloading the price list
from MeowDB. It sends nothing else anywhere.

---

## How it works

Everything is plain image processing on screenshots of the game window, done with
OpenCV and NumPy.

1. **Capture.** The game window's client area is grabbed with
   [dxcam](https://github.com/ra1nty/DXcam) (Desktop Duplication), or with
   [mss](https://github.com/BoboTiG/python-mss) when the window spans two
   monitors. About 10 times a second while a shop is open, 4 times otherwise.
2. **Normalise.** The frame is scaled to the game's base UI resolution (height
   768), so all layout geometry is in fixed "base pixels".
3. **Find the UI** by template matching (`maplestory_classic_tool/assets/*.png`):
   - shop window: its button block
   - status bar: the `LV.` box
   - inventory: the `MESOS` label
   - minimap: the `WORLD` button
4. **Read the text with the game's own pixel fonts.** Shop rows use glyph
   templates learned from labelled screenshots (`assets/glyphs.json`). The EXP
   bar and the meso box use small hand-checked digit patterns
   (`maplestory_classic_tool/exp.py`, `maplestory_classic_tool/meso.py`). Windows OCR is only a fallback.
5. **Price.** Item names are fuzzy-matched against the MeowDB catalog
   ([RapidFuzz](https://github.com/rapidfuzz/RapidFuzz)), and profit = NPC price ×
   quantity − asking price.
6. **Draw** a click-through, always-on-top Tk window over the game. It is
   excluded from screen capture (`WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE`), so step 1 never sees
   it.

## Development

```bat
.venv\Scripts\python -m pytest -q
```

The suite runs against the labelled screenshots in `tests/fixtures/shops/`. Each
`.png` has a `.json` next to it with the expected rows. Tests marked `live` need
the running game and are skipped by default.

**Preview on a screenshot.** This draws the side list and EXP box exactly as the
live overlay would:

```bat
python -m maplestory_classic_tool --image shot.png --out annotated.png [--show-all] [--exp-demo]
```

`--exp-demo` fills the EXP box with sample rates. A single screenshot otherwise
shows `—`.

**Headless mode** is always on, with no control window (Ctrl+C quits):
`python -m maplestory_classic_tool`.

**After a game UI patch**, or to teach the reader new letters:

```bat
python -m maplestory_classic_tool.calibrate draw <shot.png> --out dbg.png
python -m maplestory_classic_tool.calibrate build tests/fixtures/shops --out maplestory_classic_tool/assets/glyphs.json [--holdout NAME]
```

- `draw` overlays the detected anchor and row boxes on a screenshot.
- `build` relearns the glyph templates from the labelled fixtures. With
  `--holdout NAME` it leaves one fixture out and reports how well the result
  reads it.
- If boxes are misplaced, update `maplestory_classic_tool/assets/layout.json`. It holds every
  box relative to its anchor, in base pixels.
- `docs/glyph-checklist.md` tracks which item names were captured to teach which
  letters.

**Releases.** [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md) lists the steps: run all the
tests, write the changes in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), increase the version in
`maplestory_classic_tool/__init__.py`, push, and publish the exe as a GitHub
release. `python -m maplestory_classic_tool --version` prints the version.

**Icon.** `packaging/make_icon.py` draws `maplestory_classic_tool/assets/app.ico`; add
`--preview sheet.png` to see every size.

Contributions are welcome. New labelled screenshots of shops are especially
useful; blur your own character name first if you want to stay anonymous.

---

## Limitations

- **Windows only.**
- Made for **MapleStory Classic**'s default UI skin and fonts.
- Exclusive fullscreen may hide the overlay.
- If the game runs as administrator, the F8 / F9 hotkeys only work when MapleStory Classic Tool
  runs as administrator too. Everything else works either way.
- **Throwing stars and bullets** assume the base set size. With Claw Mastery a
  full set is larger, so the NPC pays less per star than shown.
- Prices are only as accurate as the MeowDB data.

---

## Disclaimer

This is an unofficial fan project. It isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or
connected to Nexon or MeowDB. MapleStory is a trademark of Nexon. Read your
game's terms of service and decide for yourself whether to use third-party tools.
MapleStory Classic Tool only reads pixels from your screen, but you use it at your own risk.

Please be considerate with the MeowDB API: the catalog is cached and refreshed at
most once a week.

"""Find the player-shop window by template-matching its button block (base-resolution gray)."""
import cv2
import numpy as np

CACHE_MAX_MEAN_DIFF = 4


class ShopLocator:
    def __init__(self, anchor: np.ndarray, min_score: float = 0.92):
        self.anchor = anchor
        self.min_score = min_score
        self._anchor16 = anchor.astype(np.int16)
        self._pos = None

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._pos = None

    def score(self, gray: np.ndarray) -> float:
        """Best anchor match score (TM_CCOEFF_NORMED) anywhere in `gray`; 0.0 if it does not fit."""
        h, w = self.anchor.shape
        if gray.shape[0] < h or gray.shape[1] < w:
            return 0.0
        return float(cv2.minMaxLoc(cv2.matchTemplate(gray, self.anchor, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED))[1])

    def locate(self, gray: np.ndarray):
        """Anchor top-left (x, y) in `gray`, or None when no shop window is visible."""
        h, w = self.anchor.shape
        if self._pos is not None:
            x, y = self._pos
            region = gray[y:y + h, x:x + w]
            if region.shape == self.anchor.shape and \
                    np.abs(region.astype(np.int16) - self._anchor16).mean() <= CACHE_MAX_MEAN_DIFF:
                return self._pos
        if gray.shape[0] < h or gray.shape[1] < w:
            self._pos = None
            return None
        res = cv2.matchTemplate(gray, self.anchor, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
        _, score, _, loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(res)
        if score < self.min_score:
            self._pos = None
            return None
        self._pos = (int(loc[0]), int(loc[1]))
        return self._pos

"""Frame -> verdicts pipeline (base-resolution gray frames)."""
import logging

import numpy as np

from maplestory_classic_tool.evaluate import ScanResult, evaluate
from maplestory_classic_tool.glyphs import glyph_key
from maplestory_classic_tool.shop import agrees_with_glyphs, name_agrees, parse_price, row_inks, to_listing

CACHE_MAX = 4096
ID_INK_GRAY = 128  # binarize identity boxes (dark text on the white title bar, light text on the dark name box)
# The locator matches the shop's button block, which changes when the mouse hovers a button. While the
# title strip (layout.shop_id_boxes[0]) at the last position is unchanged the shop is still open: hold it.
HOLD_PIXEL_DIFF = 48  # a title-strip pixel counts as changed above this gray difference
HOLD_MAX_CHANGED = 0.03  # at most this share of the strip may change (the game's cursor over it)
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class Scanner:
    def __init__(self, locator, layout, glyphs, catalog, settings, fallback):
        self.locator = locator
        self.layout = layout
        self.glyphs = glyphs
        self.catalog = catalog
        self.settings = settings
        self.fallback = fallback
        if hasattr(glyphs, "chars"):
            known = glyphs.chars()
            self._unknown_chars = "".join(c for c in "0123456789," if c not in known)
        else:  # fail closed: without the template list no "?" may stand for a digit
            log.warning("glyph set has no chars(); OCR cannot fill unknown price digits")
            self._unknown_chars = ""
        self._texts: dict = {}
        self._last_key = None
        self._last = ScanResult(None, [], True)
        self._title_ref = None  # title strip (gray) at the last anchored frame
        self._session_id = None  # identity of the shop for as long as it stays open

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._texts.clear()
        self._last_key = None
        self._last = ScanResult(None, [], True)
        self._title_ref = None
        self._session_id = None
        self.locator.reset()

    def _title_crop(self, gray, anchor):
        """The title strip at `anchor`, clipped to the frame; None when nothing of it is visible."""
        boxes = getattr(self.layout, "shop_id_boxes", ())
        if not boxes:
            return None
        x, y, w, h = boxes[0]
        x0, y0 = max(anchor[0] + x, 0), max(anchor[1] + y, 0)
        x1, y1 = min(anchor[0] + x + w, gray.shape[1]), min(anchor[1] + y + h, gray.shape[0])
        if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
            return None
        return gray[y0:y1, x0:x1]

    def _title_still_there(self, gray) -> bool:
        if self._last.anchor is None or self._title_ref is None:
            return False
        crop = self._title_crop(gray, self._last.anchor)
        if crop is None or crop.shape != self._title_ref.shape:
            return False
        changed = np.count_nonzero(np.abs(crop.astype(np.int16) - self._title_ref) > HOLD_PIXEL_DIFF)
        return changed <= HOLD_MAX_CHANGED * crop.size

    def _grid_region(self, gray, anchor):
        lay = self.layout
        ox, oy = lay.row_origin(anchor, 0)
        x0 = ox + min(lay.name_box[0], lay.price_box[0])
        x1 = ox + max(lay.name_box[0] + lay.name_box[2], lay.price_box[0] + lay.price_box[2])
        y0 = oy + min(lay.name_box[1], lay.price_box[1])
        y1 = oy + (lay.rows - 1) * lay.row_pitch + max(
            lay.name_box[1] + lay.name_box[3], lay.price_box[1] + lay.price_box[3])
        return gray[max(y0, 0):max(y1, 0), max(x0, 0):max(x1, 0)]

    def _shop_id(self, gray, anchor):
        """Hash of the binarized title-bar and seller-name boxes (layout.shop_id_boxes).

        Boxes reaching off the frame are clipped (the clip rectangle is part of the hash); None when
        nothing of any box is visible, so such frames are never merged into a shop's list.
        """
        ax, ay = anchor
        parts = []
        visible = False
        for x, y, w, h in getattr(self.layout, "shop_id_boxes", ()):
            x0, y0 = max(ax + x, 0), max(ay + y, 0)
            x1, y1 = min(ax + x + w, gray.shape[1]), min(ay + y + h, gray.shape[0])
            if x1 <= x0 or y1 <= y0:
                parts.append(None)
                continue
            visible = True
            crop = gray[y0:y1, x0:x1] < ID_INK_GRAY
            parts.append((x0 - ax - x, y0 - ay - y, x1 - x0, y1 - y0, np.packbits(crop).tobytes()))
        return hash(tuple(parts)) if visible else None

    def _crop(self, gray, anchor, row, box):
        ox, oy = self.layout.row_origin(anchor, row)
        x, y, w, h = box
        return gray[oy + y:oy + y + h, ox + x:ox + x + w]

    def _read(self, ink, gray, anchor, row, box, is_price):
        """(text, unknown, raw_unknown) with the fallback policy applied; cached by glyph key.
        raw_unknown: unknown glyphs of the glyph read itself, before any OCR fill."""
        key = glyph_key(ink)
        hit = self._texts.get(key)
        if hit is not None:
            return hit
        res = self.glyphs.read(ink)
        text, unknown = res.text, res.unknown
        raw_unknown = unknown
        if unknown > 0 and self.fallback is not None:
            fb = self.fallback.read(self._crop(gray, anchor, row, box))
            if is_price:
                if fb and parse_price(fb)[0] is not None and agrees_with_glyphs(text, fb, self._unknown_chars):
                    text, unknown = fb, 0
            elif fb and name_agrees(text, fb):  # a wrong OCR name would map to a wrong item/NPC price
                text, unknown = fb, 0
        if len(self._texts) > CACHE_MAX:
            self._texts.clear()
        self._texts[key] = (text, unknown, raw_unknown)
        return text, unknown, raw_unknown

    def scan(self, gray: np.ndarray) -> ScanResult:
        anchor = self.locator.locate(gray)
        if anchor is None and self._title_still_there(gray):
            # hover over the shop's buttons: same shop, same rows; no identity, so nothing is merged
            self._last = ScanResult(self._last.anchor, self._last.verdicts, False, None)
            return self._last
        if anchor is None:
            self._last_key = None
            self._title_ref = None
            self._session_id = None
            changed = self._last.anchor is not None or bool(self._last.verdicts)
            self._last = ScanResult(None, [], changed)
            return self._last
        title = self._title_crop(gray, anchor)
        self._title_ref = None if title is None else title.astype(np.int16)
        # The shop cannot change while its window stays open, so its identity is fixed until it closes
        # (the game's cursor over the title or seller name would otherwise look like another shop).
        if self._session_id is None:
            self._session_id = self._shop_id(gray, anchor)
        shop_id = self._session_id
        key = (anchor, hash(self._grid_region(gray, anchor).tobytes()))
        if key == self._last_key:
            self._last = ScanResult(self._last.anchor, self._last.verdicts, False, shop_id)
            return self._last
        lay = self.layout
        verdicts = []
        for ri in row_inks(gray, anchor, lay):
            name, _, n_raw = self._read(ri.name, gray, anchor, ri.row, lay.name_box, False)
            price, p_unknown, p_raw = self._read(ri.price, gray, anchor, ri.row, lay.price_box, True)
            listing = to_listing(ri.row, name, price, p_unknown, name_unknown=n_raw > 0,
                                 price_filled=p_raw > 0 and p_unknown == 0)
            verdicts.append(evaluate(listing, self.catalog, self.settings.min_profit))
        self._last_key = key
        self._last = ScanResult(anchor, verdicts, True, shop_id)
        return self._last

"""Build glyphs.json from labelled shop screenshots; draw layout debug images.

python -m maplestory_classic_tool.calibrate build FIXTURE_DIR --out maplestory_classic_tool/assets/glyphs.json [--holdout NAME]
python -m maplestory_classic_tool.calibrate draw SHOT.png --out dbg.png
"""
import argparse
import difflib
import json
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

import cv2
import numpy as np

from maplestory_classic_tool.catalog import fold_il
from maplestory_classic_tool.glyphs import GlyphSet, binarize, column_runs, glyph_key
from maplestory_classic_tool.layout import Layout, load_layout, to_base
from maplestory_classic_tool.shop import collapse_digit_spaces

ASSETS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "assets"
DEFAULT_PRICE_FORMAT = "{qty} for {price:,} mesos"
DEFAULT_SPACE_GAP = 3  # only used when the training lines contain no gaps at all
DEFAULT_TOLERANCE = 0.0  # base-resolution rendering is pixel-exact: exact matches only
_DIGITISH = frozenset("0123456789,")


def price_text(qty: int, price: int, fmt: str = DEFAULT_PRICE_FORMAT) -> str:
    return fmt.format(qty=qty, price=price)


@dataclass
class Fixture:
    name: str
    shop: bool
    rows: list  # dict | None | "occluded" per visible row
    gray: np.ndarray  # base resolution


@dataclass
class Line:
    source: str
    text: str
    ink: np.ndarray
    touching: tuple = ()  # label hint: substrings drawn as one run (e.g. "xt" in "Dexterity")


@dataclass
class BuildReport:
    glyphs: GlyphSet
    trained: int
    skipped: list = field(default_factory=list)
    conflicts: list = field(default_factory=list)  # sorted (char, char) drawn identically
    multi: list = field(default_factory=list)  # learned multi-char templates (touching runs)
    holdout_lines: int = 0
    wrong: int = 0
    unknown: int = 0
    unknown_chars: list = field(default_factory=list)  # holdout label chars read as "?"


def load_fixtures(fixture_dir: Path, layout: Layout) -> list:
    out = []
    for js in sorted(Path(fixture_dir).glob("*.json")):
        data = json.loads(js.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        gray = cv2.imread(str(js.with_suffix(".png")), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
        if gray is None:
            raise FileNotFoundError(js.with_suffix(".png"))
        base = tuple(data.get("base_size", layout.base_size))  # captures at other window sizes carry theirs
        out.append(Fixture(js.stem, bool(data["shop"]), list(data["rows"]), to_base(gray, base)))
    return out


def match_anchor(gray: np.ndarray, anchor: np.ndarray) -> tuple:
    """Best anchor position (x, y) and its TM_CCOEFF_NORMED score."""
    res = cv2.matchTemplate(gray, anchor, cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED)
    _, score, _, loc = cv2.minMaxLoc(res)
    return (int(loc[0]), int(loc[1])), float(score)


def box_ink(gray: np.ndarray, origin: tuple, box: tuple, ink_max_gray: int) -> np.ndarray:
    ox, oy = origin
    x, y, w, h = box
    return binarize(gray[oy + y: oy + y + h, ox + x: ox + x + w], ink_max_gray)


def fixture_lines(fixtures: list, layout: Layout, anchor: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    """{fixture name: [Line]} for every labelled (dict) row: name line, then price line."""
    out = {}
    for f in fixtures:
        if not f.shop:
            continue
        axy, _ = match_anchor(f.gray, anchor)
        lines = []
        for r, row in enumerate(f.rows):
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                continue
            origin = layout.row_origin(axy, r)
            lines.append(Line(f"{f.name} row {r} name", row["name"],
                              box_ink(f.gray, origin, layout.name_box, layout.ink_max_gray),
                              tuple(row.get("touching", ()))))
            lines.append(Line(f"{f.name} row {r} price",
                              price_text(row["qty"], row["price"], layout.price_format),
                              box_ink(f.gray, origin, layout.price_box, layout.ink_max_gray)))
        out[f.name] = lines
    return out


def word_gaps(ink: np.ndarray, text: str) -> tuple:
    """(intra-word gaps, inter-word gaps) in px, or (None, None) if runs != chars.

    Gaps between two digits/commas are left out of intra: digits are tabular, so the gap
    after "1" is as wide as a word gap; collapse_digit_spaces repairs those reads.
    """
    runs = column_runs(ink)
    if len(runs) != len(text.replace(" ", "")):
        return None, None
    intra, inter = [], []
    i, prev, space_before = 0, None, False
    for ch in text:
        if ch == " ":
            space_before = True
            continue
        if i > 0:
            gap = runs[i][0] - runs[i - 1][1]
            if space_before:
                inter.append(gap)
            elif not (prev in _DIGITISH and ch in _DIGITISH):
                intra.append(gap)
        prev, space_before, i = ch, False, i + 1
    return intra, inter


def _diff(expected: str, got: str) -> tuple:
    """(wrong, label substrings read as '?'). wrong = chars read as a different non-'?'
    char, plus chars dropped or invented."""
    wrong, unknown_chars = 0, []
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, expected, got, autojunk=False)
    for op, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
        if op == "equal":
            continue
        read = got[j1:j2]
        wrong += sum(1 for c in read if c != "?")
        wrong += max(0, (i2 - i1) - len(read))
        if "?" in read:
            unknown_chars.append(expected[i1:i2])
    return wrong, unknown_chars


def _word_groups(runs: list, space_gap: int) -> list:
    groups = [[runs[0]]] if runs else []
    for prev, run in zip(runs, runs[1:]):
        if run[0] - prev[1] >= space_gap:
            groups.append([run])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(run)
    return groups


def _split_known(seg: np.ndarray, known: dict, widths: list):
    """Text of a run as a concatenation of known templates (exact matches, widest first,
    as GlyphSet.read splits touching glyphs), or None."""
    t = known.get(glyph_key(seg))
    if t:
        return t
    out, pos, w = [], 0, seg.shape[1]
    while pos < w:
        for wd in widths:
            if wd <= w - pos:
                t = known.get(glyph_key(seg[:, pos:pos + wd]))
                if t:
                    out.append(t)
                    pos += wd
                    break
        else:
            return None
        while pos < w and not seg[:, pos].any():
            pos += 1
    return "".join(out)


def _units(word: str, touching: tuple) -> list:
    """The word as runs: each `touching` substring (labelled as drawn joined) is one unit, other chars one each."""
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(word):
        for t in sorted(touching, key=len, reverse=True):
            if t and word.startswith(t, i):
                out.append(t)
                i += len(t)
                break
        else:
            out.append(word[i])
            i += 1
    return out


def build(lines: dict, holdout: str = None, tolerance: float = DEFAULT_TOLERANCE) -> BuildReport:
    """Train a GlyphSet from labelled lines (label "I" is folded into "l").

    Pass 1: lines whose run count equals the char count give single-char templates and
    the space gap. Pass 2: other lines are split into words at the space gap; a word whose
    run count equals its char count adds singles; otherwise its runs are matched against
    known templates (whole run, or split into known templates) from both ends and, if
    exactly one run is left, it becomes a template
    for the leftover substring (touching glyphs, e.g. "tt"). Repeated until nothing new is
    learned; words still left with 2+ unmatched runs are skipped and reported.
    """
    templates = {}  # (glyph_key, text) -> ink
    known = {}  # glyph_key -> text (last wins, as in GlyphSet exact lookup)
    seen = {}  # glyph_key -> set of texts
    skipped = []

    def learn(text, seg):
        key = glyph_key(seg)
        seen.setdefault(key, set()).add(text)
        templates.setdefault((key, text), seg)
        known[key] = text

    intra, inter, pending = [], [], []
    for name, ls in lines.items():
        if name == holdout:
            continue
        for ln in ls:
            text = fold_il(ln.text)
            runs = column_runs(ln.ink)
            chars = text.replace(" ", "")
            if len(runs) == len(chars):
                gi, ge = word_gaps(ln.ink, text)
                intra += gi
                inter += ge
                for ch, (x0, x1) in zip(chars, runs):
                    learn(ch, ln.ink[:, x0:x1])
            else:
                pending.append((ln, text, runs))
    if intra:
        space_gap = max(intra) + 1
        if inter:
            space_gap = min(space_gap, min(inter))
    else:
        space_gap = min(inter) if inter else DEFAULT_SPACE_GAP

    words_todo = []  # (line, word, [ink per run])
    multi = []
    for ln, text, runs in pending:
        words = text.split()
        groups = _word_groups(runs, space_gap)
        if len(groups) != len(words):
            skipped.append(f"{ln.source}: {ln.text!r} words={len(words)} "
                           f"run groups={len(groups)}")
            continue
        for word, group in zip(words, groups):
            segs = [ln.ink[:, x0:x1] for x0, x1 in group]
            units = _units(word, ln.touching)
            if len(segs) == len(units):
                for unit, seg in zip(units, segs):
                    learn(unit, seg)
                    if len(unit) > 1:
                        multi.append(unit)
            else:
                words_todo.append((ln, word, segs))

    progress = True
    while progress and words_todo:
        progress, rest = False, []
        widths = sorted({seg.shape[1] for seg in templates.values()}, reverse=True)
        for ln, word, segs in words_todo:
            i, j, ci, cj = 0, len(segs), 0, len(word)
            while i < j:
                t = _split_known(segs[i], known, widths)
                if not t or not word.startswith(t, ci, cj):
                    break
                i, ci = i + 1, ci + len(t)
            while j > i:
                t = _split_known(segs[j - 1], known, widths)
                if not t or not word.endswith(t, ci, cj):
                    break
                j, cj = j - 1, cj - len(t)
            if j - i == 1 and cj > ci:
                sub = word[ci:cj]
                learn(sub, segs[i])
                if len(sub) > 1:
                    multi.append(sub)
                progress = True
            elif not (j == i and cj == ci):  # fully explained words are simply dropped
                rest.append((ln, word, segs))
        words_todo = rest
    for ln, word, segs in words_todo:
        skipped.append(f"{ln.source}: {ln.text!r} word {word!r} "
                       f"runs={len(segs)} chars={len(word)}")

    glyph_dict = {}
    for (_, text), seg in templates.items():
        glyph_dict.setdefault(text, []).append(seg)
    gs = GlyphSet(glyph_dict, space_gap, tolerance)
    conflicts = sorted({tuple(sorted(t)) for t in seen.values() if len(t) > 1})
    rep = BuildReport(gs, len(templates), skipped, conflicts, sorted(set(multi)))
    for ln in lines.get(holdout, []) if holdout else []:
        r = gs.read(ln.ink)
        wrong, unknown_chars = _diff(collapse_digit_spaces(fold_il(ln.text)),
                                     collapse_digit_spaces(r.text))
        rep.holdout_lines += 1
        rep.wrong += wrong
        rep.unknown += r.unknown
        rep.unknown_chars += unknown_chars
    return rep


def draw(shot: Path, out: Path, layout: Layout, anchor: np.ndarray) -> float:
    bgr = cv2.imread(str(shot))
    if bgr is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(shot)
    w, h = layout.base_size
    base = bgr if bgr.shape[:2] == (h, w) else cv2.resize(bgr, (w, h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_AREA)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(base, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    (ax, ay), score = match_anchor(gray, anchor)
    img = cv2.resize(base, None, fx=2, fy=2, interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)

    def rect(x, y, bw, bh, color):
        cv2.rectangle(img, (2 * x, 2 * y), (2 * (x + bw) - 1, 2 * (y + bh) - 1), color, 1)

    rect(ax, ay, anchor.shape[1], anchor.shape[0], (0, 0, 255))
    cv2.putText(img, f"{score:.3f}", (2 * ax, 2 * ay - 4), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, 0.5,
                (0, 0, 255), 1)
    for r in range(layout.rows):
        ox, oy = layout.row_origin((ax, ay), r)
        rect(ox, oy, layout.name_box[0] + layout.name_box[2], layout.row_pitch, (255, 0, 0))
        rect(ox + layout.name_box[0], oy + layout.name_box[1], *layout.name_box[2:], (0, 160, 0))
        rect(ox + layout.price_box[0], oy + layout.price_box[1], *layout.price_box[2:],
             (0, 160, 255))
        cv2.drawMarker(img, (2 * (ox + layout.label_dx), 2 * (oy + layout.row_pitch // 2)),
                       (255, 0, 255), cv2.MARKER_CROSS, 10)
    cv2.imwrite(str(out), img)
    return score


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m maplestory_classic_tool.calibrate")
    p.add_argument("--layout", type=Path, default=ASSETS / "layout.json")
    p.add_argument("--anchor", type=Path, default=ASSETS / "anchor.png")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    b = sub.add_parser("build")
    b.add_argument("fixture_dir", type=Path)
    b.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    b.add_argument("--holdout")
    b.add_argument("--tolerance", type=float, default=DEFAULT_TOLERANCE)
    d = sub.add_parser("draw")
    d.add_argument("shot", type=Path)
    d.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    a = p.parse_args(argv)

    layout = load_layout(a.layout)
    anchor = cv2.imread(str(a.anchor), cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
    if anchor is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(a.anchor)
    if a.cmd == "draw":
        score = draw(a.shot, a.out, layout, anchor)
        print(f"anchor score={score:.3f} -> {a.out}")
        return 0
    lines = fixture_lines(load_fixtures(a.fixture_dir, layout), layout, anchor)
    if a.holdout and a.holdout not in lines:
        p.error(f"holdout {a.holdout!r} is not a labelled shop fixture")
    rep = build(lines, a.holdout, a.tolerance)
    for s in rep.skipped:
        print(f"skipped {s}")
    for c in rep.conflicts:
        print("identical bitmap for chars " + " ".join(map(repr, c)))
    if rep.multi:
        print("multi-char templates: " + " ".join(map(repr, rep.multi)))
    if rep.unknown_chars:
        print("holdout label chars read as '?': " + " ".join(map(repr, rep.unknown_chars)))
    rep.glyphs.save(a.out)
    print(f"trained={rep.trained} glyphs, holdout lines={rep.holdout_lines}, "
          f"wrong={rep.wrong}, unknown={rep.unknown}")
    return 1 if rep.wrong > 0 else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

class FakeOcr:
    def __init__(self, name_text, price_text):
        self.name_text, self.price_text, self.calls = name_text, price_text, []

    def read(self, crop):
        self.calls.append(crop.shape)
        return self.name_text if len(self.calls) % 2 else self.price_text  # name, then price per row


def test_fallback_policy(layout, anchor, glyphs, catalog, frame2):
    class EmptyGlyphs:
        """Glyph set that reads nothing: every box has unknown glyphs."""
        def read(self, ink):
            from maplestory_classic_tool.glyphs import ReadResult
            return ReadResult("", 3)

    fb = FakeOcr("Wolbi Throwing Stars", "1 for 3,000 mesos")
    sc = Scanner(ShopLocator(anchor), layout, EmptyGlyphs(), catalog, Settings(), fb)
    v0 = sc.scan(frame2).verdicts[0]
    # no known glyph to agree with: the OCR name is not trusted (it could map to a wrong item)
    assert v0.listing.name == ""
    # glyphs read nothing known: OCR price has no positional evidence, so it stays unknown
    assert (v0.listing.qty, v0.listing.price, v0.listing.uncertain) == (None, None, True)

    # unparseable fallback price: stays uncertain -> unknown
    fb2 = FakeOcr("Wolbi Throwing Stars", "garbage")
    sc2 = Scanner(ShopLocator(anchor), layout, EmptyGlyphs(), catalog, Settings(), fb2)
    v = sc2.scan(frame2).verdicts[0]
    assert v.listing.uncertain and v.status == "unknown"

class _ForcedPriceGlyphs:
    """Real glyph reads for names; every price box reads as partially unknown."""
    def __init__(self, real, price_text, drop=""):
        self.real, self.price_text, self.drop = real, price_text, drop

    def chars(self):
        return self.real.chars() - set(self.drop)

    def read(self, ink):
        res = self.real.read(ink)
        if " for " in res.text:
            from maplestory_classic_tool.glyphs import ReadResult
            return ReadResult(self.price_text, 1)
        return res


class _PriceOcr:
    def __init__(self, price_text):
        self.price_text = price_text

    def read(self, crop):
        return self.price_text


@pytest.mark.parametrize("ocr_text", [
    "1 for 300 mesos",        # dropped digit
    "1 for 3,00 mesos",       # dropped digit, bad grouping
    "1 for ,000 mesos",       # leading comma
    "1 for 3,,000 mesos",     # doubled comma
    "1 for 2,500 mesos",      # digit disagrees with glyph read
    "1 for 3 000 mesos",      # gap collapses to 3000 but comma is missing
])
def test_misread_fallback_price_never_profits(layout, anchor, glyphs, catalog, frame2, ocr_text):
    sc = Scanner(ShopLocator(anchor), layout, _ForcedPriceGlyphs(glyphs, "1 for 3,?00 mesos", drop="8"),
                 catalog, Settings(), _PriceOcr(ocr_text))
    res = sc.scan(frame2)
    assert res.verdicts
    assert all(v.status != "profit" for v in res.verdicts)
    assert all(v.status == "unknown" for v in res.verdicts)


def test_agreeing_fallback_price_still_accepted(layout, anchor, glyphs, catalog, frame2):

                 catalog, Settings(), _PriceOcr("1 for 3,000 mesos"))
